robot.name: Noetix N2
robot.generation: N2 generation short humanoid research platform
robot.status_notes: Multiple sources report pre-orders open in 2025, with pre-orders passing 500 then 1,000 units and reportedly more than 2,500 orders. MERA Robotics lists N2 as in development and not openly sold, so treat as pre-order/research platform rather than widely shipping.

height.notes: Reported by The Robotic Life, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; Other outlets report 1.2 m (P2) or 1.3 m (P1, P3); 118 cm is the figure given by the spec databases (P5, P6, P7, P8)..

weight.notes: Reported by en.tmtpost.com, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; P3 gives 20 kg (44 lbs), likely an earlier/incorrect figure; 30 kg is corroborated by P5, P7 and P8 (66 lbs)..

payload.notes: Reported by Humanoid.guide, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; Given as walking payload; P7 lists “Payload: 5 kg”..

runtime.notes: No runtime found for N2 in reviewed sources.

battery.notes: No battery capacity found for N2 in reviewed sources.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Reported by Mike Kalil and Robotic Gizmos; 18 degrees of freedom.

walking_speed.notes: Reported by en.tmtpost.com, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; Top running speed. P3 says 3.2 m/s; P1 says 11 km/h; P6 lists 12.6 km/h (≈3.5 m/s)..

compute.description: NVIDIA Jetson Orin; supports up to 8GB of video memory via edge computing.

actuators.description: Peak torque up to 120 Nm reported for dynamic movements.

availability.notes: Conflicting prices: 39,000 yuan (Yahoo, Mike Kalil), 59,900 yuan (TMTPost for N2, though it also mentions 39,900 yuan for mass production), 39,900 yuan (TMTPost mass production, MERA). Official Noetix YouTube video title says starting at $7,999. No official purchase URL found in reviewed sources.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: No credible evidence of dexterous manipulation or hands was found for N2 in the reviewed sources. The robot is not described with grippers or manipulation demos.
caveats: No hand or manipulation disclosure found.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: N2 uses deep reinforcement learning for anthropomorphic walking and pre-trained models for simple tasks, but no autonomous task demo was found. Teleoperation status is not disclosed for any video.
caveats: Company claims only; no independent verification.
No explicit autonomy statement in reviewed videos.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: Strong evidence of dynamic mobility: continuous backflips, running at up to 3.5 m/s (sources vary), jumping, dancing, rough terrain, and endurance walking after abuse. Finished second in Beijing humanoid half marathon.
caveats: Demo videos not independently verified.
Conflicting top speed and height/weight figures.
No fall rate or success rate published.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: Two depth cameras provide 3D perception; edge computing up to 8GB video memory; supports visual/speech interaction with an LLM.
caveats: No scene understanding benchmark or real-world perception demo in reviewed sources.

human_interaction.summary: N2 supports visual/speech interaction with an LLM, has four microphones and a speaker. It is marketed for education, research, live streaming, security patrols and training companionship.
caveats: No demonstrated conversational capability or reliability metrics found.

endurance_reliability.summary: Evidence includes finishing second in Beijing humanoid half marathon, a video caption saying it endures serious abuse and keeps walking, and reported order volume implying some production. No runtime or battery spec published.
caveats: Half marathon result from a directory, not a primary event report.
Abuse video not reviewed; teleoperation status unknown.
No runtime or battery specification found.

human_environment_fit.summary: Small child-sized biped (1.2-1.3 m, 20-30 kg) intended for research/education; no safety certification or human-proximity testing disclosed.
caveats: Conflicting height/weight figures.
No safety disclosures found.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: Multiple media report pre-orders surpassing 500 then 1,000 units, and Robotics & Automation News reports more than 2,500 orders. No named customers or deployment sites.
caveats: Order numbers are company claims via media, not independently audited.
No named deployments or output metrics.

accessibility_value.summary: Low price point reported between 39,000 and 59,900 yuan depending on source; official channel video title says starting at $7,999; open for pre-orders.
caveats: Conflicting price figures.
No official purchase URL in reviewed sources.
Pre-order status, not confirmed shipping.

evidence_items.title: Height, bipedal and speed claim from Yahoo Finance
evidence_items.claim: Noetix N2 is a 1.3-metre-tall bipedal robot capable of travelling up to 11 km/h across rough terrain.
evidence_items.notes: Media report relaying company claims; speed not independently verified.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Defines basic size and mobility envelope.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: The 1.3-metre-tall bot is bipedal and capable of travelling at speeds of up to 11 kilometres per hour across rough terrain.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Conflict with other height/speed reports noted in specs.

evidence_items.title: Estimated price from Yahoo Finance
evidence_items.claim: Noetix N2 has an estimated price tag of 39,000 yuan (£4,100).
evidence_items.notes: Price is estimated and conflicts with other sources.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Low price point is a key differentiator.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Beijing-based Noetix Robotics built the N2 humanoid bot to serve as a budget-friendly robot assistant, with an estimated price tag of 39,000 yuan (£4,100).
evidence_items.verification_notes: Conflicting prices from TMTPost and Mike Kalil.

evidence_items.title: Compute and AI capabilities from Yahoo Finance
evidence_items.claim: Noetix N2 is equipped with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin chip for perception and interaction, plus generative AI for ChatGPT-style communication and pre-trained models for simple human tasks.
evidence_items.notes: Company claim relayed by media.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Supports human interaction and simple task claims.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Noetix Robotics said the robot comes equipped with an advanced Nvidia Jetson Orin chip that give it "powerful perception and interaction capabilities".
evidence_items.verification_notes: No independent benchmark or demonstration.

evidence_items.title: N2 specs from TMTPost
evidence_items.claim: N2 stands 1.2 meters tall, weighs 30 kilograms, and can backflip, run, jump on single/double legs, and dance.
evidence_items.notes: Interview with founder; specs conflict with other sources.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: The robot, named N2, stands 1.2 meters tall, weighs 30 kilograms, and boasts an impressive range of motion, including backflips, large strides, running, single- and double-leg jumps, and even dancing.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Height and weight conflict with Mike Kalil/MERA.

evidence_items.title: Max running speed from TMTPost
evidence_items.claim: N2 has a maximum running speed of 3.5 meters per second.
evidence_items.notes: Company claim via interview.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: With a maximum running speed of 3.5 meters per second, the N2 is a standout in the humanoid robotics space.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Conflicts with 11 km/h and 3.2 m/s from other sources.

evidence_items.title: Price conflict and preorder status from TMTPost
evidence_items.claim: N2 is priced higher at 59,900 yuan, while E1 starts at 39,900 yuan; both are open for pre-orders.
evidence_items.notes: This conflicts with other sources reporting 39,000/39,900 yuan for N2.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: The price of E1 starts at 39,900 yuan, while the N2, with fewer joint degrees of freedom and a shorter height, is priced higher at 59,900 yuan—a seemingly counterintuitive strategy aimed at making robotics more accessible.
evidence_items.verification_notes: TMTPost elsewhere mentions 39,900 yuan for mass production, adding confusion.

evidence_items.title: Pre-orders surpass 500 units
evidence_items.claim: Pre-orders for N2 and E1 surpassed 500 units, according to founder Jiang Zheyuan.
evidence_items.notes: Company figure given in media interview; not audited.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Jiang shared that pre-orders for the N2 and E1 have beat expectations, surpassing 500 units.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Later sources report 1,000 and 2,500 orders; no independent verification.

evidence_items.title: Intended applications from TMTPost
evidence_items.claim: N2 is designed for education, scientific research, live streaming, security patrols, and training companionship.
evidence_items.notes: Official positioning via founder interview.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: The N2 is designed for a wide range of applications, including education, scientific research, live streaming, security patrols, and training companionship.
evidence_items.verification_notes: No evidence of these use cases in operation.

evidence_items.title: Weight and DoF from Mike Kalil
evidence_items.claim: N2 weighs 20 kg and has 18 degrees of freedom.
evidence_items.notes: Blog citing Noetix website; conflicts with TMTPost weight.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: On its website, NOETIX Robotics calls the N2 light and athletic. It weighs 20 kg (44 lbs) and has 18 degrees of freedom (DoF).
evidence_items.verification_notes: No official manufacturer page reviewed; weight conflict.

evidence_items.title: Availability and price from Mike Kalil
evidence_items.claim: N2 is heading toward mass production and will be available starting at 39,000 yuan ($6,200).
evidence_items.notes: Blog citing company; price conflicts with TMTPost 59,900 yuan.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: The company says the robot is heading toward mass production and will be available starting at 39,000 yuan ($6,200).
evidence_items.verification_notes: No official pre-order URL found.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: Noetix N2 is a small, inexpensive Chinese bipedal research/education humanoid with strong dynamic mobility demos (continuous backflips, running, jumping, abuse recovery) and a reported low price, but it has no manipulation evidence, no autonomous task execution proof, no named customers, and many conflicting specs.
strongest_positive_evidence: Continuous backflip video and dynamic motion claims from multiple sources.
Finished second in Beijing humanoid half marathon.
Video caption says robot endures serious abuse and keeps walking.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No autonomous task demo or teleoperation disclosure.
No payload, runtime, battery, or hand specs.
Conflicting height, weight, speed and price figures.
conflicting_claims: Max speed: 3.2 m/s vs 3.5 m/s vs 11 km/h.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit N2 with dexterous manipulation or hand use.
Do not claim autonomous operation; teleoperation is not disclosed.
Do not treat order numbers as verified commercial deployment.
Do not use a single spec figure as authoritative due to conflicts.

currentness.currentness_notes: N2 is still listed as Noetix's research/education platform as of 2026. Noetix has also launched Bumi, a cheaper consumer humanoid, and E1, a full-sized humanoid, but N2 remains the known backflipping model.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: Noetix N2 is a small Chinese bipedal humanoid (1.2-1.3 m, 20-30 kg, 18 DoF) from Noetix Robotics, known for continuous backflips, running, and low price. Strongest evidence is dynamic mobility demos including backflips and an abuse recovery video, plus reported pre-orders of over 2,500 units and a second-place finish in a humanoid half marathon. However, there is no evidence of manipulation, no autonomous task execution disclosure, no named customers, and specs/price are highly conflicting.
strongest_evidence: Continuous backflip demonstration reported by multiple sources.
Video caption 'Noetix N2 endures some serious abuse but keeps walking.'
Second place in Beijing humanoid half marathon.
weakest_evidence: No autonomous task demo or teleoperation disclosure.
Conflicting height, weight, speed and price.
known_do_not_credit: Bumi or E1 specs as N2.
Any single spec or price as authoritative.
